description: Searches licensed US mortgage loan officers listed on bluerate.ai by state, optionally near a city or ZIP code, for a loan type (conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, jumbo, non-QM, home equity: HELOC or home equity loan) or by a language they speak. Returns up to 10 loan officers, each with name, NMLS ID, company, office city, licensed states, loan types, languages, number of reviews and url: the loan officer's public bluerate profile, where people read reviews and request a callback. Also returns total (how many match) and moreResultsUrl (the full list on bluerate). Results are filtered by state license, not office location; city and zip only rank nearby offices first. Results contain no phone numbers or email addresses.

city.description: City name, for example San Jose. Puts loan officers with an office there first; does not filter.

language.description: A language the loan officer speaks, as a name (Spanish, Chinese) or a code (es, zh).

limit.description: How many loan officers to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

loanType.description: Only loan officers who do this loan type in the state. home_equity is a HELOC or home equity loan. Leave it out for every loan type.

state.description: US state as a two-letter code, for example CA or TX. Full names like California also work.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code, for example 94105. Puts loan officers with an office there first; does not filter.

name: search_loan_officers
title: Find mortgage loan officers
